name: IEC PNP phototransistor: photosensitive pnp transistor
summary: PNP phototransistor form: Photosensitive PNP Transistor.
description: A PNP phototransistor uses incident light to control a PNP transistor current path. The emitter arrow and supply orientation distinguish it from the NPN form. This entry identifies the photosensitive pnp transistor form in the publisher's IEC-context family.
A light-sensitive input stage can feed a conditioning circuit without a separately driven base connection. Check the emitter and collector assignments before following the measurement current.
A PNP phototransistor is different from a photodiode: its transistor action adds current gain, with different speed and bias requirements.
